source.label: FY2024 Form 10-K, Note 17 Related Parties and Related-Party Transactions
source.quote: As of December 31, 2024, Advance Magazine Publishers Inc. ("Advance") held approximately 23% of our outstanding shares of Class A and Class B common stock and is a related party to Reddit as Advance holds more than 10% of the voting power of our outstanding Class A and Class B common stock.

structure.note: Class B shares carry ten votes each, Class A one vote, and Class C none (none outstanding). CEO Steven Huffman holds irrevocable voting proxies over the shares of Advance and of Tencent entities; with his own shares the 2025 proxy gives him 75.8% of total voting power, and the 10-K says Reddit is eligible to be a 'controlled company' under NYSE rules.

notes: Fiscal year ended December 31, 2024 (matches data.js fy 'Dec 2024'). Financial figures are from the FY2024 Form 10-K (accession 0001713445-25-000018), reported in thousands; the stock-comp value matches SEC XBRL. Ownership is from the 2025 proxy statement (DEF 14A filed April 28, 2025, accession 0001713445-25-000092), based on 129,145,465 Class A and 55,121,821 Class B shares outstanding at March 31, 2025. LEADER: Alexis Ohanian, co-founder, is not a director, nominee, named executive officer or 5% holder in the 2025 proxy, so no holding is reported. HOLDERS: the proxy gives 5% holders only as percentages of each class and of voting power, not of all shares, so only Advance is recorded, from the 10-K's stated all-class figure (approximately 23% at December 31, 2024). For reference, the proxy's class figures at March 31, 2025 are: Advance Magazine Publishers 16,182 Class A and 42,191,092 Class B (76.5% of Class B, 62.0% of votes); FMR LLC 13,062,873 Class A (10.1%) and 3,215,857 Class B (5.8%), 6.7% of votes; entities affiliated with Tencent 7,751,457 Class A (6.0%) and 4,660,372 Class B (8.4%), 8.0% of votes; The Vanguard Group 9,181,390 Class A (7.1%); Coatue Management 6,530,236 Class A (5.1%). These are not converted to all-share percentages here. Steven Huffman's own holding is 1,175,115 Class A (1.0%) and 3,897,083 Class B (6.9%), 5.8% of votes; his 75.8% voting total adds the Advance and Tencent shares he votes by proxy. BUYBACKS: no share repurchases in 2024; the $294.6 million of taxes paid on net share settlement of RSUs is not a buyback. STOCK COMP: the record uses the cash-flow figure of $801.6 million (2023: $47.6 million; the jump follows the March 2024 IPO); the 10-K's segment and adjusted-EBITDA tables also show $842.9 million of 'stock-based compensation expense and related taxes', which adds the related taxes. PLAN: the 10-K lists an Employee Stock Purchase Plan only as an exhibit and does not describe it, so plan is null.
